comment: Where the golden path has been OBSERVED to stop. tests/e2e/ratchet.test.ts asserts that every step at or before passing_through PASSED, and that the first step after it FAILED carrying next_step_fails_with in its message. Moving this file forward is mechanically the only way to green the ratchet once a stage lands its step, so progress is extracted by a failing gate rather than reported by a human. The move is a one-line diff in the pull request that delivered the work.
the_rule: THE FRONTIER MOVES ONLY ON AN OBSERVED RUN OF THE STEP BEING CLAIMED. It is never advanced by reasoning about what a stage will make pass. This file was first written with passing_through set to magic-link-expired-refused, because Stage 0 was going to make those four steps pass -- at a moment when tests/e2e held nothing that could run, no auth harness existed, and admin/generate_link had never been called against this GoTrue. Validating the file's structure established that it was well-formed. It could not establish that the frontier was true, and only a run can do that. A field defined as where the path currently stops, holding a plan instead, is a claim present and not reaching -- sitting in the input to the one gate built to catch exactly that shape.
reason: Nothing has been observed to pass yet. null is the honest bootstrap state, and it is not a placeholder to be filled in from the plan: the first value here comes from the first run of the golden path.
next_step_fails_with_contract: Describes the step IMMEDIATELY AFTER the frontier, so it is rewritten on every move, and it is filled from the failure that was actually observed rather than the failure that was expected. Ratchet assertion (2) checks that the first step past the frontier FAILED, not WHY -- a step failing with 'ReferenceError: sql is not defined' satisfies it exactly as well as one failing because the RPC does not exist, which is a check reporting a verdict for a reason unrelated to what it guards. This key names the exact signal, never a negation. It must be non-null whenever the ratchet has a junit to read; null is valid here only while passing_through is also null.
recorded_derivation_not_yet_asserted: When the frontier reaches magic-link-expired-refused, the next step is session-resolves-to-ward-account and the expected failure is NOT_A_MEMBER -- public.my_facility_wards() selects facility_id into a null and calls app.assert_member, which raises NOT_A_MEMBER with ERRCODE 42501 when the ward_account lookup finds nothing. This is recorded so the derivation is not done twice. It is NOT recorded so it can be pasted into next_step_fails_with ahead of the run that confirms it.
provisional_until_first_real_run: DISCHARGED, NOT DELETED, on the first real run: this value is then replaced by the record of what was observed -- the GoTrue version from /auth/v1/health and the actual admin/generate_link response field names. Until then it stands as a caveat: the whole step sequence assumes admin/generate_link followed by POST /auth/v1/verify works against the GoTrue shipped with the pinned Supabase CLI, and if the response shape differs the steps are rewritten against what came back.
